claim: For fixed \(p\in(0,1)\), \(a>0\), and \(m=\lfloor n^a\rfloor\), independent Bernoulli-\(p\) coloring of an \(m\times n\) row/column \(\mathsf{S5}\) frame has depth-one graded-modal type count \(K_1/F_a(n)\to1\) in probability, where with \(v=p(1-p)\) and \(L_v=\int_{\mathbb R}(1-e^{-e^{-x^2/(2v)}/\sqrt{2\pi v}})\,dx\), the five consecutive regimes \(0<a<1/2\), \(a=1/2\), \(1/2<a<2\), \(a=2\), \(a>2\) have normalization \(F_a(n)\) equal respectively to \(4\sqrt{2v(1-a/2)}n^{3a/2}\sqrt{\log n}\), \(4L_v\sqrt{3v/2}n^{3/4}\sqrt{\log n}\), \(16v\sqrt{(a-1/2)(1-a/2)}n^{(a+1)/2}\log n\), \(4L_v\sqrt{3v}n^{3/2}\sqrt{\log n}\), and \(4\sqrt{2v(a-1/2)}n^{3/2}\sqrt{\log n}\). Moreover \(K_1/(2RC)\to1\) in probability for \(R\) and \(C\) the observed numbers of distinct row and column sums; the depth-one definable Boolean algebra has exactly \(2^{K_1}\) elements.

correctness.rationale: Every depth-one graded-modal cell type is exactly its color and two named degree counts; binomial occupancy asymptotics have separate sparse, Gaussian critical and logarithmic-boundary proofs; central degree-interval uniform two-color coverage holds by independent columns or rows and a polynomial union bound; constants and both transitions result by multiplication. Exact formula checks on 9,418 small matrices, 9 binomial critical comparisons and 32 random rectangles agree. The finite tests do not claim to establish convergence.

title: Five-regime aspect-ratio law for one-round graded modal types in random epistemic grids

value.rationale: The simultaneous quantification of grade-modal first-round expressivity and a two-color degree-pair saturation theorem is natural for message-passing/finite modal-type complexity. The five polynomial-aspect regions feature two sharp transition exponents with distinct Gaussian constants, and an exact square-grid 8p(1-p)n log n law; each is absent from qualitative random depth-two separation. The complete phase diagram exceeds a routine numerical example.
